report:
Implemented pending-status polling in `src/usePreparation.js`. A `false` response now schedules another preparation check; only `true` marks that activity’s token completed. Retry callbacks are generation-guarded, so stale results/callbacks from close, reopen, token changes, or unmount cannot affect the active dialog. Archived the patch at `/workspace/download-dialog-pending-polling.patch`.

Validation: lifecycle harness passed pending→retry→ready, stale ready after token switch, and retry after close; `/runtime/node --check src/usePreparation.js` passed. Node: v18.17.0. The patch archive reverse dry-run applies (with benign context fuzz). No project test suite was present, so no browser/render integration test was run.
